prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7 and 8 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_two_column_redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column layout with a playful mascot visual preview alongside path descriptions. (why: The choose_path step has a 23.8% drop-off and a long mean completion time of 514s, showing hesitation during path selection.)
1: [finish, new_screen] pet_interaction_tutorial_screen: Add a new tutorial screen at the end of onboarding that walks through dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the desktop pet. (why: Support receives frequent complaints about users not knowing how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] photo_upload_quality_guidance_flow: Introduce photo quality guidelines and tip carousels during pet photo upload to prevent corrupted pet generation. (why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9%, and support received multiple reports of custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_reorder_after_pick_friend: Move the sign-in step to occur right after picking a friend companion, before starting photo uploads or certificates. (why: Asking users to sign in before choosing a pet causes a 27.1% drop-off; picking a pet first builds commitment.)
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_interactive_tips: Display progress indicators, time estimates, and desktop usage tips on the waiting screen while the pet initializes. (why: The waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing users to drop off if they believe the app has frozen.)
5: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_reassurance_hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that the path selection can be re-configured anytime in app settings. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing user indecision due to fear of making an irreversible choice.)
6: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_account_persistence_copy: Add sign-in body copy emphasizing using the same account method to avoid account duplication or pet loss. (why: Support logged 8 emails about pets missing or reset after users signed in again with a different login method.)
7: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_launch_copy: Update the home intro text to give explicit directions on where the pet appears on screen and how to click it. (why: Finish step drops off to 64.8% and support receives issues regarding pets not appearing or users failing to open/find them.)
